verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-intelligence API platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The adjacent items (an llms.txt file, a Python SDK, a CLI and REST APIs) are developer building blocks or other features, not an MCP server, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
